text.title: Niche Scorecard Decision Tree
text.summary: Routes on how many candidate niches are genuinely in play, whether any candidate fails a knock-out gate, and whether a measured quantity exists behind each criterion — to a full weighted comparison with a sensitivity check, an outright reject, or a skip when there is nothing to compare against.

decision-tree.root-question: How many candidate niches are genuinely still in play — ones the founder would actually pursue if the score came out in their favour?

branch.when: one candidate only; the real question is go / no-go on a niche already chosen

conclusion.verdict: skip; a weighted comparison of one candidate scores nothing. Run the hard gates as a standalone check and size the niche with market-research-tam-sam-som

branch.when: two or more candidates are live and the decision is which one to pursue
branch.question: Does any candidate hit a knock-out condition — a licensing or regulatory barrier the founder cannot clear, no reachable acquisition channel, a legal bar to operating there?

branch.when: at least one candidate fails a knock-out condition

conclusion.verdict: set that candidate to reject before any scoring; gates never enter the weighted sum and never receive a weight. Re-check whether 2 or more candidates survive

branch.question: Is a measured quantity obtainable per criterion per niche — SAM in currency, count of funded direct competitors, median deal size or gross margin, months to first revenue, shipped work in the domain?

branch.when: scores would come from impression or enthusiasm, with no observable behind Market Size, Competition or Your Fit

conclusion.verdict: halt; gather the observable behind each criterion first. Unanchored 1-10 scores rank the founder's mood, not the niches

branch.when: every criterion has a citable measured quantity for every surviving niche

conclusion.verdict: apply the full methodology; freeze weights summing to 1.0 with the largest at least twice the smallest before scoring, keep criteria on independent quantities, then re-rank under a plus/minus 20% weight perturbation before declaring a winner
